object_description: compact two-story composition enclosing a central auditorium
design_condition: Placed at the north-eastern corner, the compact building preserves valuable trees and open space while adding a new access and path connection to the district.

positive.statement: The clear positioning does not disturb the existing primary school complex as a whole.
The large, contiguous open space with the trees worth preserving will largely be preserved.
The calm and unpretentious architectural language fits into the existing school complex.
The visual connections through the auditorium result in easy orientation in the building.
The separate access to the day structures and music and support rooms offers the necessary intimacy.
The flexible room layout can be ideally set up for both age groups.
The simple, clear arrangement ensures problem-free use of the individual areas.
The room program is well organized and allows dual use of the rooms.
The estimated investment costs are in the favorable range.

negative.statement: The loggia's usability and quality of stay, compared to the park, are not convincing.
Closing the volume could strengthen the clarity of the building.
The staircase from the terrace to the garden needs to be checked and may not be convincing due to its arrangement.
The project could be made more compact by closing the loggia.
